en: You're...

Tranquilo, Joe!
Chill out.
Is he another one of the Lunatics?

That's another Lunatic... Naito.
They say he's just as strong as Okada himself.

I can't believe they're already
throwing Naito at us.

Excuse me? Look here. Don't go making it
sound like I got ordered to come here.

I'm here 'cause I wanna be here.
Nobody told me to do it. Not even Okada.

Truth is, I've got a reason for
trekking all the way to Onomichi.

Kiryu-san... That reason is you.
You're a muy interesante fellow.

The former Tojo Clan fourth chairman, and
the renowned Dragon of Dojima... Kazuma Kiryu.

Huh!? The Tojo Clan? Um, Kiryu-san...
You're in the yakuza?

Used to be.
I'm just a civilian now.

I've got tons of yakuza and mafia amigos floating
around, so the name Kiryu immediately rang a bell.

In case you forgot... I'm Naito.
Buenas noches, Kiryu-san.
Guess you and me don't gel too good, huh?

The legends about you are muy grande, though.
Every time I hear one, I feel like I'm gonna puke.

Guys like you and Joe are the worst. Always trying
to act the hero for some bullshit sense of honor.

I've always wanted to knock you guys down a peg.
Never thought I'd actually get the chance.
So you want to fight?

Tranquilo, Kiryu-san!
Chill out.

Didn't you just finish fighting Yano? It'd be way too
boring to beat you when you're not at your peak.

Besides, I'm not interested in just fighting
one-on-one with no clear purpose.

I'd rather squash all your little friends... then
take my sweet time with the head honcho.

Your friend is hurt here.
At least take him with you.

Huh. Y'know, friend is way too strong a word.
Besides, we don't need failures in the Lunatics.

No point bringing him back now.
Might as well end things clean and simple.
You bastard... Naito...
Don't do it, Naito.

You never change, Joe. Okada's the same way.
Seriously makes me wanna barf.

Looks like Kiryu's not gonna be flying solo
in the afterlife now. You get to join him, Joe.
You'll see.

I just can't believe you're
really a famous yakuza, Kiryu-san.
It's all in the past.

But you were some kinda chairman, right?
No surprise you're good at leading a team.

We trust you no matter what, Kiryu-san.
Your past life doesn't change that.

If anything, I'm glad to know you're on our side
and not theirs. We have a lot to learn from you.

I'm not all that special.
You shouldn't put me on a pedestal like that.

That's a lot of bull! Have a bit more
confidence in yourself, Kiryu-chan!

You sure about this? I dunno if I really
want this guy on our team...
It's fine by me.
He did say he was turning over a new leaf.

Hell yeah! JUSTIS is the worst of the worst! I knew
Kiryu-chan was my man the moment we locked fists!

We're gonna make a great team!
Good shit!
This guy is bonkers...

He's definitely strong, though. If we want
to beat Naito, we'll need people like him.

I got this. I don't feel a shred of remorse about
JUSTIS, by the way. It's nothing but hate now.

I mean, I'm a proud dude.
I'll do whatever it takes to bring 'em down.
Right. I appreciate the help.

Toru Yano!
I'm on the case!

As for our next guy, Naito... Apparently he's got
a pretty crazy number of followers on his side.

He was saying he's got ties to mafia and yakuza
groups, too. Pretty shady, if you ask me.

I dunno what he's doin' with the Lunatics...
But apparently Okada pays him the big bucks.

His group's way different than the rat pack
I shuffled on down here with, too.

Ya better watch your backs. Things're gonna
get tough if you don't prepare for him.
Got it.

Not bad, though unsurprising from the fourth chairman.
For the time you've had, your team is muy bueno.

At first these little battles were real entertaining.
But now... they're just starting to bore me.
So the next one's gonna be the last.

If you guys manage to beat me...
I'll take JUSTIS forces out of Onomichi.
Si. No way you're gonna win against me, though.

I've just been messing with you guys so far.
I'm gonna give you all I got from now on.

Once I take your newly formed team down a notch,
you're all gonna be muy muerto. I can see it now.
I can't wait to make it happen for real.
Hey, Naito.
Chill out.
You bastard... Just you wait.

So our next battle is a showdown with Naito.
We need to make sure we're ready to rumble.
It's just about time to take on Naito.

He said he'd pull outta Onomichi if we win...
You think he meant it?

I would assume he did.
He's not the kinda guy to go back on his word.

Besides, JUSTIS would have no business sending guys
down here with both Naito and Yano out of the picture.

They shouldn't even be sending guys down to
Onomichi in that kinda situation.

They'll probably just focus on solidifying
their forces in Kamurocho instead.

Right. Guess we'd just had to focus on
those remaining guys after that, then.
Sounds like this is a major turning point, then.

That's right.
We need to win this, no matter what.

All right, everyone.
It's time we move out!

Hell yeah! We're gonna smoosh Naito
like a dumb little bug! C'mon, you guys!

Buenas noches!
Kiryu-san, Joe.

We're here, just like you asked.
Now let's finish this.
No need to remind me. I remember.

As a sign of my respect to you,
I brought along my elite squad.
Sorry, but this is the Kiryu Clan's last fight.
We'll see about that.

Bring it on.
Let's get this fiesta started!

Huh, I didn't think you'd be this strong.
Guess I underestimated you a bit.

Now then...
How about a one-on-one with me?
That's what you wanted, right?
You sure?

You've still got hombres left standing. It'd be
easier for you to just come at me with everyone.

That's not really my style. I'd rather fight
with honor than crush you unfairly.

Aha. So that must be what keeps
drawing all these people to you.

I've gotta say, you make me sick.
But I'm no idiota. I'll take you up on your offer.
Kiryu-san... It's time to fight, mano a mano.
Right. Let's get it over with, Naito.
Tranquilo! Chill out, Kiryu!

Oh my god!
Kiryu-san, you beat Naito!
Are you okay?

I totally lost...
You're really something, Kazuma Kiryu.

You promised. 
Pull your JUSTIS goons out of Onomichi.

Don't worry about that. With Yano and I beat, JUSTIS
won't have the cajones to be sending guys down here.

Besides, a promise is a promise.
The Onomichi invasion's over.

All right! We protected Onomichi,
just like we set out to do!
All we can do now is head up to Kamurocho.
Okada... I'm coming for you.

All right. Let's head back to the hideout
and plan our next attack.
Hey, Kiryu-san.
Uh... Take me with you.
What was that?

I used to think I couldn't stand self-righteous,
chivalrous bastards like you and Joe.

But y'know, beneath that hate...
was admiration.

Kazuma Kiryu.
I wanna learn to be more like you.

Let me join you guys.
I wanna be your pareja.

Naito on our team? Who knows when
he'd turn on us. I can't trust him!

No, he's being genuine. I get how
he can be so drawn to Kiryu-san...
Joe-san, I didn't know you swing that way...
D-Don't be an ass!

I'm not really sure what pareja means...
but you can come along if you want.

We'll be heading to Kamurocho next.
Until then, try to heal up.
It appears Naito has fallen as well.
I see. Figures.

Shall we reconvene the whole
of our army here in Kamurocho, then?

Yes, get started.
The battle's moving to our home turf.

But it's just the beginning.
So let's make sure... they get a warm welcome.
Joe... Kazuma Kiryu...
Okada and Komei are the only ones left now.
They're up in Kamurocho.

Next time you head up there,
we'll gladly join you.

When you have the chance,
stop by the hideout in Kamurocho.
Looks like Onomichi's gonna be okay.

The rest of the Six Lunatics are gonna
be waiting for us up in Kamurocho, though.

We don't know exactly when we're
gonna have the chance to head up there.

But for now, we should focus on building up
the team down here in Onomichi.

We'd probably get our butts kicked in a second
if we head up there without any preparation.

You're right. We should make sure we're
ready before we bring the team up to Kamurocho.
I could tell that was you from a mile away.

Hold on, are you living here
in the Navy Apartments, Kiryu-san?

I am. By the way, are you sure
you should be out and about like this?

It's not too big a deal, I don't think.
What are you up to, Kiryu-san?
Well... I'm about to head up to Kamurocho.

I'm leaving tomorrow.
I'll be out of Onomichi for a while.

Hold on, but Kamurocho...
That's where JUSTIS is based, you know.

This has nothing to do with them.
I have other business I need to take care of.
Oh. In that case...
Is something wrong?

No, I was just thinking of you spending time
up in Kamurocho. It gave me an idea.

Well, I should go tell Masao and the others
what you're gonna be up to. Later!
Kiryu-san. Good to see you.
What the? Joe!

What are you doing here?
I don't understand.

We were gonna have to make our way on up
to Kamurocho at one point or another, right?

Coming up at the same time as you made the most
sense. It was easy to get everyone on board, too.

Everyone's here...?
Come on.

Isn't that a good thing?
It means we're all serious about this.

Speaking of, we got hold of a store
we can use as a hideout while we're up here.

It's a little shop inside the Millennium Tower
building called the M Side Cafe.
Want to go see it?

I guess I have to...
Just for a bit, though.

This is a pretty swanky place.
Are you sure we'll be okay here?

Well, the bartender down at La Pente apparently
knows the owner. He helped negotiate for us.

Seriously?
What's up with that guy?

Look what the cat dragged in!
You're really here, Joe.
It's you...

Ya can't hide from us.
We know your every move, Joe.

And you took time out of your day to welcome us?
That's a real nice gesture of you. Appreciate it.

Joe. Now that you've come to Kamurocho,
don't expect any mercy from us.

This is JUSTIS's home base. You won't have
the same freedom here as you did in Onomichi.

We know damn well where your base is.
We wouldn't be here otherwise.

Anyway... Whaddya say?
Let's fight, you and me. Like old times.
Heh... Nope.

This man is the renowned Rainmaker, remember?
He has no time for an insignificant whelp like you.
Besides... You have others in line waiting to fight you.
Don't go forgettin' about us, Joe.

You get to deal with us next time.
I've been damn bored lately. Entertain me.
Tenzan, Kojima...
Hey, Joe. Who are these guys?

The Six Lunatics tag team, Tenzan and Kojima.
TenCozy for short.

They're part of the reason Okada and I formed
JUSTIS to begin with. They were in the colors.

The color gangs?
How did they end up working with JUSTIS?

Okada probably paid through the nose for them.
They're real assholes, but they're definitely strong.

Each is tough alone, but their power
multiplies when you pair them together.
That's why they're TenCozy.

Not bad, Joe-kun.
Sounds like ya know your shit.

You're right. We might've switched over to the side
of JUSTIS, but we'll always be champs! Forever!

One plus one don't make two. For us, one plus one
is two hundred! That's ten times better! Ten times!

Hey... You wanna check that math?
Shouldn't it be one hundred times better?

I don't care for your lip!
It's just a crapton more than two, alright!?

If you're really givin' me shit for this,
I'd be glad to rip ya a new one!

Now, now. We cannot allow one of our mighty
Six Lunatics to sully himself with this garbage.

Stooping to his level is not the desired
outcome. Isn't that right, Rainmaker?
Yeah, true.

Though come to think of it,
have we met before?
Yeah, I think we have.
Heh... What a coincidence this is.

I have no ill will toward you... But if you
try to stop me, I'll crush you where you stand.

JUSTIS is the sole dominant force
in Kamurocho at this point.

It's been ages since we've had a good fight.
This should be exciting.

I hope you provide us with some
entertainment, Kiryu Clan. We must be off.
Watch your backs, bastards.

So those are the leaders of JUSTIS.
Sounds like more fights on the horizon.

Right. Anyway, this place is gonna be our
hideout while we're up in Kamurocho.

Come talk to me if you want to reorganize
the team or start a battle against JUSTIS, okay?
You're actually kinda strong, Kiryu-san.

It's been forever since I've had to put my all
into fightin' someone. Feels good.
Still, we're gonna have to settle this soon.
Hey, Tenzan!

We're gonna finish ya guys off next time.
Come at us with all ya got, okay?
